title: Frosted Crater: Aerial Traversal

foundation.history: A forgotten impact-hollow vault once protected basalt shelters, until recurring cryogenic pockets forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Daro Halden, a pilot, must deliver emergency medicine, relying on wind-aware movement despite cryogenic pockets.
central_conflict: a disrupted air network threatens the impact-hollow vault by restricting basalt shelters.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: cryogenic pockets destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a disrupted air network contests access to basalt shelters
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
